note: Franklin County MS planning page says it covers unincorporated-area zoning districts and links only to a County GIS Maps viewer (experience.arcgis.com). The viewer exposes no REST service URL. The county's public FeatureServer (Franklinms_Service) has parcels, voting precincts, districts and city limits but no zoning layer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web for Franklin County MS or Meadville/Bude zoning found no queryable district layer; no city zoning service was found either.
